regions.full_page: TO RESCUE FROM DESPAIR: THE HOPE AND THE SOULS OF BILLIONS. HOPE, THE VERY LIFE OF HAPPINESS IN THIS WORLD: DESPAIR? UGLIEST PHASE OF HELL-EXISTENCE. "KNOW THE TRUTH AND THE TRUTH SHALL MAKE YOU FREE" When shall we be delivered, or how extricate ourselves from the fearful nightmare, so long a solemn prophecy; now, as of over night a most threatening reality: - Nay, become an international problem, se- cond to hardly another - the nightmare so pathetically lamented when Jesus, grieved at their want of appreciation and consequent ingrati- tude, wept over Jerusalem saying: " .. And if in this thy day thou hadst known the things that are for thy peace, but now they are hid- den from tine eyes ..... and you shall hear of wars and rumors of wars. .... And you shall be hated for my sake ... and they will put you to death for my sake ... And these things they will do to you because they have not known the Father nor me." Plainly in other words, be- cause they have not knon the Truth, God eternal. And saddest of all, To-day as then, so many of us do not really care to know. Without realizing it we are so naturally inclined to live for the present and to prize temporal advantages as if there were nothing better to hope for. Temporal things - which in the sight of Heaven, must mean but - momentary - become all - important. Death and eternity, Heaven and Hell are lost from view. The primary purpose of the rational crea- ture, to know God and his first and most important duty of consequent gratitude, become like to that of the ox and the ass that have no understanding. Our natural trend where religion is wanting is always away from God and Truth; and the farther we drift from God and Truth, so much the farther do we stray from the divine Source of peace, of hope and of charity. Just so much the more too do the words of di- vine Lementation apply to us: "With desolation is all the world made desolate, because there is none that thinketh in the heart." Truth? Prophecy? War-Problem? How simple to the man of faith! How infallible the solution Jesus, Eternal Truth gives! And as will be found after all, the only solution: "Know the Truth and the Truth shall make you free."
